title: Meta funds two TerraPower Natrium reactors, with options for up to eight

sources.quote: Our agreement with TerraPower will provide funding that supports the development of two new Natrium® units capable of generating up to 690 MW of firm power with delivery as early as 2032.

explain: Meta is funding TerraPower's development of two new Natrium sodium-cooled reactors (up to 690 MW, power as early as 2032), with rights to more units (Meta says up to eight in total). No dollar amount was disclosed. Plants: planned TerraPower Natrium units (not yet built, sites not named).
